logline: A righteous IPS officer is deployed to Kolkata after a cop killing, slowly unravelling a criminal network woven from police corruption, political money, and Bengal underworld muscle.

renewal.note: Produced as a standalone limited series set in Bengal. No second season announced as of mid-2026.

bollymeter.basis: Rotten Tomatoes landed at 56% across 9 critics, with Scroll.in and Free Press Journal noting period atmosphere and unpredictable moments, while Decider and The Indian Express flagged familiar genre beats and predictable character arcs.

pull_quotes.text: Despite overused crime show tropes, The Bengal Chapter has attention to detail as well as elements of unpredictability.

seasons.review_body: The second entry in Netflix India's Khakee franchise relocates from Bihar to Kolkata, swapping Neeraj Pandey for a new creative team while keeping the franchise's cops-versus-machine template. Jeet makes his Hindi OTT debut as IPS officer Arjun Maitra and brings screen presence to a role that the writing keeps underpowered. Prosenjit Chatterjee as the protected gangster Bagha is the standout - veteran Bengali cinema credibility elevating every scene. The 56-percent Rotten Tomatoes tally (9 critics) reflects a genuine split: production design earns praise from most, while the narrative's genre familiarity draws comparisons to reheated templates. IMDb audiences tracked more generously at 7.5, consistent with the franchise's loyal base. Serviceable crime viewing, but nowhere near the Bihar Chapter's sustained tension.
